messages:
Alex G: Quick sync — we need to finalize the partner handoff cadence for marketplace / hardware partners / SIs. Proposal:
- Shared channel per partner for SEV handling
- Channel naming: #partner-{org}-sev (ephemeral) and #partner-{org}-ops (long-lived)
- 2-hour initial response SLA for oncall, 15-min bridge for SEV1
- War-room template + private NDA warroom option for SIs
Thoughts?

Maria L: +1. We still get confusion between driver/kernel-level HW incidents vs Redwood infra issues. Need explicit routing for "driver bug" vs "runtime degradation" so partner knows whether to engage vendor support.

Prateek S: Suggest escalation ladder per partner: L1 partner frontline -> L2 Redwood SE (triage + logs) -> L3 Eng + Vendor. Add a contact matrix with phone + pager. Also recommend a single canonical state field in the warroom: "owner" to avoid double-handoffs.

Samir K: Can we standardize channel creation? I propose: `#partner-<org>-sev-YYYYMMDD` for active SEVs (auto-archived after close) and `#partner-<org>-ops` for ongoing ops/roadmap. We should wire a webhook that creates a Zoom bridge and pins runbook links when an SEV channel is created.

Elaine T: Legal/product note: some SIs require NDA-protected warrooms with restricted access and audit logging. We need a checklist for what metadata is allowed in those channels (no customer PII by default). Also KMS/HSM notes for Private deployments — ensure partner oncall has access flow documented.

Alex G: I'll draft a minimal war-room template. Key fields: severity, impact, customer, region, oncall names, partner contacts, quarantine/rollback steps, artifacts (logs/snapshots), postmortem owner.

Prateek S: Here's a compact template we can start with — please copy into the shared doc and iterate:
```text
Severity: SEV1 / SEV2 / SEV3
Customer: <org name>
Impact: <brief summary, e.g. inference errors 100% or latency > 3s p95>
Region: <aws-eu-west-1>
Primary oncall (Redwood): <name + pager>
Partner contact: <name / email / pager>
Bridge: <zoom link>
Immediate mitigation: <kill model / scale pool / restart worker>
Rollback plan: <model version / infra rollback>
Artifacts: <links to logs, traces, heapdumps>
Owner for PM: <name>
```

Samir K: Nice. For the webhook action we should also auto-populate a short checklist in-channel: `@here SEV1 — verify quotas, check driver versions, confirm kernel logs, escalate to vendor`. Helps reduce initial cognitive load.

partner-oncall-bot: Zoom bridge created: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 (pin: 4321) — channel topic set to "SEV1 / Acme Corp"

Maria L: Also proposing monthly 30-min tabletop drills with each high-touch partner (marketplace vendors, top 3 HW OEMs, and the two largest SIs). Measure: time-to-first-ack, time-to-owner, MTTR. I'll take ownership of Q2 cadence if that's ok. :calendar:

Elaine T: Legal will prepare a short access request template for NDA-warrooms and confirm retention limits. We should include an explicit checklist for what telemetry can be shared with partners (no raw customer payloads).

Alex G: Next steps: 1) I'll create the shared Google doc and invite partners + ops. 2) Maria to schedule Q2 drills and own contact matrix. 3) Samir to prototype channel-creation webhook + Zoom integration. 4) Elaine to draft NDA-warroom access template.

Samir K: I'll mock the webhook this week and post the repo link. We can keep the initial implementation internal and iterate with partners.

Maria L: Sounds good. I'll also compile common HW failure runbooks (OOM, PCIe/driver mismatches, NVLink errors) so the war-room can link to remediation steps quickly.

Alex G: Great — let's sync for 1 hour next Tue 10am PT to review the doc + kickoff the webhook prototype. Please add any missing contacts to the shared spreadsheet once I post it. :thumbsup:

prateek: ack

Maria L: ack

Samir K: ack

Elaine T: ack
